name: Sisters of Sigmar
special_rules:
## Daughters of the Heldenhammer
---
All `Sisters of Sigmar` fighters have access to the following rules:

### [Trait] Sigmar’s Blessing
This fighter may call for one of Sigmar's Blessings by spending saved Wyrd Dice:

- **Heart of Steel:** During this fighter’s activation, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to automatically pass a panic test.
- **Righteous Fury:** During this fighter’s activation, after making a hit roll, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to turn a hit into a critical hit.
- **Sigmar Protects:** During an enemy fighter’s activation, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to perform a reaction with this fighter without needing or spending an action to do so.

### [Reaction] Martyrdom
A fighter can make this reaction when they suffer enough damage to take them out of action, but before removing them from the battlefield. Gain a [double] with a value of 1. If this fighter is a `Hero`, gain a [triple] with a value of 1 instead. If this fighter is a `LEADER`, gain a [quad] with a value of 1 instead.

name: Mercenaries
special_rules:
When creating a Mercenary warband, you must select two of the following rules to represent your warband’s home province:

### Huntsmen
Increase the Shoot characteristic of all Marksmen by 1.

### Hardy
Increase the Health characteristic of all Militia and Champions by 2.

### State Troopers
Increase the Fight characteristic of all Militia by 1.

### Well Drilled
At the end of each Aftermath Sequence, select one Henchman to earn 1 Renown.

### Unyielding
Increase the Bravery characteristic of all fighters by 1.

### Wealthy Patrons
Gain an additional 20gc when collecting income in the aftermath sequence.

### Well-connected
Reduce hiring fee of Hired Swords by 50%

### Deeply Religious
Roll 7 initiative dice in each initiative phase instead of 6.

### Desperate
You cannot recruit Warriors or Marksmen, but Youngbloods are free.
